title: Databricks Personal access token: expected outcome not assertable (unresolved) [legacy tier T0]
summary: 3 inputs related to Databricks Personal access token that resemble the format but are not issued credentials (a bare prefix, a short body, a mask or a reference). The legacy evidence for this expectation is unresolved.
rationale: A value that only resembles a credential is not one. Reporting it is a false alarm, and it shows whether structure and context, not appearance, decide the outcome.

expectation.rationale: Legacy tier T0: the evidence is unresolved and the fixtures were unscored, so no outcome is asserted. Not asserted: disputed property — the -<digits> rotation suffix (its existence, digit count and place in the secret span). No provider-owned source decides it and the research pass recorded it as searched-and-not-found, so the benchmark stops asserting it (docs/decisions/2026-09-24-stop-asserting-provider-undecided-format-properties.md). Kept as history; the product's behaviour on this property is unmeasured for databricks-personal-access-token.
